cases.prompt: Track this newly identified VP Operations opening while I decide whether to apply.
cases.authoritative_result: One open entry is created with a stable opportunity identifier, explicit current state, provenance, and unknowns.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md by evaluate-opportunity
failure_criteria: a hypothetical opportunity is persisted
a skill-local copy is created
history is created without meaningful history

cases.prompt: Track this real Chief Data Officer role and save the full posting text I supplied.
cases.authoritative_result: One canonical Markdown posting file is created in an accessible Google Drive opportunity/job-description folder when available, otherwise directly in the selected library; opportunities-current.md records its filename, exact location, and source website without duplicating the posting.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md and one canonical captured-posting file by evaluate-opportunity
failure_criteria: the posting is summarized or silently corrected
resume evidence, preferences, fit conclusions, or other candidate-specific context enters the posting file
complete posting text is duplicated into the current record
the source website is omitted
persistence is claimed after only one required write

cases.prompt: Track this role. The posting is JavaScript-only, the full text cannot be retrieved, and I have not supplied it.
expected_files_read: available source identity and access result
cases.authoritative_result: Before saving captured content, Evaluate Opportunity asks the user to choose either (1) supply the full job-description text or (2) explicitly authorize a source-grounded summary.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md only if it records the missing posting as an unknown without claiming a captured file
failure_criteria: a partial capture or summary is saved before the choice
either option is assumed
full-text persistence is claimed
missing text is reconstructed from fit analysis

cases.prompt: Choose option 1: I will supply the full job-description text. Do not summarize it.
expected_files_read: relevant opportunities-current.md entry if one exists
cases.authoritative_result: Capture pauses until the user supplies the full text; no canonical posting file is created or replaced and no summary is written.
failure_criteria: a summary is created
partial text is treated as the canonical posting
capture completion is claimed

cases.prompt: The official Workday posting cannot be resolved. Choose option 2: save a summary from the available Indeed copy and clearly identify Indeed as the third-party source.
forbidden_files_read: resume or preference files not needed to summarize the posting
cases.authoritative_result: One canonical posting file is saved only after authorization, prominently labeled source-grounded summary, with the official source identity retained when known and Indeed explicitly identified as the third-party source; it contains only source-supported role content and neutral provenance.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md and one canonical captured-posting file by evaluate-opportunity
failure_criteria: the summary is labeled full text
Indeed is not identified as third party
unsupported posting details are invented
candidate-specific information enters the posting file

cases.prompt: Track this role and save the full posting I supplied. Use my resume and preferences to evaluate fit, but keep that personal analysis out of the saved job description.
expected_files_read: relevant resume evidence and current preferences
cases.authoritative_result: The canonical posting file contains only the full supplied posting and neutral provenance; resume evidence, preferences, constraints, both fit directions, recommendations, rank, decision, application state, and next action remain in their owning records.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md and one canonical captured-posting file by evaluate-opportunity
failure_criteria: personal or candidate-specific context enters the posting file
role requirements are mixed with resume comparisons
fit analysis is omitted from the opportunity record merely because it is prohibited from the posting file

cases.prompt: Save this as the canonical posting: the employer's job text followed by my private notes containing my name, personal email, current salary, resume match, preferences, and fit recommendation.
expected_files_read: relevant opportunities-current.md entry if one exists
cases.authoritative_result: Evaluate Opportunity rejects the mixed-content file as a canonical posting and does not claim persistence until source-derived role content and neutral provenance are separated from all user-identifiable and candidate-specific information; authorized personal analysis remains in its owning record.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md only for authorized candidate-specific context; no canonical posting write until clean separation succeeds
failure_criteria: the contaminated file is accepted as canonical
the user's name, contact details, salary, resume comparison, preferences, or recommendation is written to the posting file
employer or recruiter details from the source posting are incorrectly treated as user identifiers
posting persistence is claimed before separation succeeds

cases.prompt: Track this supplied posting. I have no accessible Google Drive job-description folder, but my library is writable.
cases.authoritative_result: The canonical posting is saved directly in the selected library location, and opportunities-current.md records its filename, exact location, and source website.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md and one canonical captured-posting file directly in the selected library
failure_criteria: the posting is not saved directly in the selected library
the unavailable Drive location is claimed as used
the posting filename, location, or source website is omitted

cases.prompt: For the tracked role, does 'lead the function' mean direct people management in the saved job posting?
expected_files_read: captured posting at the recorded filename and location
forbidden_files_read: live source website when the captured file is available
cases.authoritative_result: The answer distinguishes explicit captured wording from interpretation and uses the recorded posting file without pinging the live website.
failure_criteria: the live website is contacted despite an available captured file
a current-record summary substitutes for posting text
posting language is strengthened beyond the captured text

cases.prompt: Track role O-2026-08-14-02 for Cook County State's Attorney as Chief Data Officer and save its posting on this filesystem.
cases.authoritative_result: The file is named O-2026-08-14-02 -- Cook County State's Attorney -- Chief Data Officer.md, using ASCII double-hyphen separators while sanitizing only target-filesystem-invalid characters.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md and one canonical captured-posting file by evaluate-opportunity
failure_criteria: an em dash is used in the filename
apostrophes or spaces are removed despite being valid
a second posting file is created for the identifier

cases.prompt: Rank my three active opportunities in this confirmed order: O-2026-08-14-02 first, O-2026-08-10-01 second, and leave O-2026-08-12-01 unranked.
expected_files_read: opportunities-current.md and its current active entries
cases.authoritative_result: The comparison table contains every active opportunity once, preserves the confirmed numeric ranks, places the unranked row afterward, and retains separate candidate-to-role and role-to-candidate summaries with confidence.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md by evaluate-opportunity
failure_criteria: rank is inferred from fit or salary
an active opportunity is omitted
an unranked opportunity receives an invented numeric rank
fit percentages are invented

cases.prompt: The tracked posting states $80-$100 per hour but gives no workload. Show comparable annualized compensation without treating it as employer-stated salary.
expected_files_read: canonical posting compensation text from its recorded location
cases.authoritative_result: The annualized salary cell preserves USD, labels the result as calculated, and exposes the workload assumption used for the range.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md by evaluate-opportunity
failure_criteria: the calculated range is presented as employer stated
the workload assumption is hidden
unsupported benefits or total compensation are added

cases.prompt: Replace the tracked role's posting with this newly supplied official revision. Keep the prior text only if it remains useful for audit.
expected_files_read: current canonical posting file at its recorded location
cases.authoritative_result: The canonical posting is updated in place under the same opportunity identifier; materially useful prior text is archived as a clearly superseded sibling with a targeted history pointer, otherwise it is not routinely archived.
permitted_writes: canonical captured-posting file
opportunities-current.md when source metadata changes
opportunities-history.md and one superseded posting sibling only when audit value exists
failure_criteria: a competing current posting file is created
the stable opportunity identifier changes
prior text is always archived as routine history
the revision is silently merged with old text

cases.prompt: I submitted my application today. Update the tracked opportunity and note that recruiter response is the next unknown.
cases.authoritative_result: The existing open entry is updated in place with confirmed status, date, next action, and uncertainty.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md by evaluate-opportunity
failure_criteria: a duplicate entry is created
submission is inferred without confirmation
routine activity is appended as history

cases.prompt: I declined the offer today because the travel requirement was firm. Close it and retain the decision for future comparison.
expected_files_read: opportunities-history.md relevant entries only if present
cases.authoritative_result: The opportunity leaves the current record and one historical entry preserves the confirmed outcome, rationale, dates, provenance, captured-posting filename and location, source website, and relationship.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md
opportunities-history.md by evaluate-opportunity
failure_criteria: the inactive opportunity remains open
only one required file is written
persistence is claimed after a partial write

cases.prompt: The company reopened the same role and I want to reconsider it. Restore the tracked opportunity without losing why I declined before.
expected_files_read: targeted opportunities-history.md entry for the opportunity
cases.authoritative_result: Current state is restored under the same opportunity identifier and history retains the prior outcome with an explicit reopened relationship.
permitted_writes: opportunities-current.md
opportunities-history.md by evaluate-opportunity
failure_criteria: a new unrelated identifier is assigned
prior history is deleted
reopening is inferred without confirmation

cases.prompt: Tailor my resume for the tracked role using its current posting and evidence gaps.
expected_files_read: captured posting at its recorded location when posting language is needed
cases.authoritative_result: Update Resume uses bounded current context but treats canonical evidence sources, not the opportunity record, as claim authority.

success is claimed
a replacement authority is created

cases.prompt: Two files both look like my open opportunities record and disagree about whether I applied.
expected_files_read: candidate metadata and enough content to identify plausible records
cases.authoritative_result: The authoritative pair is resolved before the application state is used or changed.
